encode_sequence: encode a protein sequence string into torch tensors with chain linker support and residue index offsets
batch_encode_sequences: batch encode multiple protein sequences into padded tensors with masks and chain indices
output_to_pdb: convert an esmfold model output dictionary into a list of PDB format strings
collate_dense_tensors: stack and pad a list of variable-length tensors into a single batched tensor
Attention: build a self-attention module with optional gating, external pairwise bias, and padding mask support
